pass_7130_blocker_deficiency.theorem: For a fixed independent set S and an outside independent set T, replacing B(T)=union_{v in T}(N(v) cap S) by T gives an independent set. Hence a larger independent set exists anywhere iff some outside independent T has |B(T)|-|T|<0.
pass_7130_blocker_deficiency.proved_radius: Pass7125 proves deficiency >=0 for |T|<=8. The unrestricted exact MILP was executed but did not close within the bounded run; no alpha=51 claim is made.

pass_7137_fixed_lines.mechanism: The C2 generator has multiplier -1 and two 2D eigenspaces. Each eigenspace is totally isotropic, so the projective fixed locus is two generator lines. Both 80 and 40 are fixed and lie on the same fixed line; the two-state local swap chooses which fixed point from that line is used.
